noAccess.title: You don't have access to receivables
noAccess.body: Receivables & credit needs the permission {permission}. Ask a person who manages roles.

band.label: Day and actions
band.asOfLabel: Count what customers owe as of this day
band.exportHeld: Nothing to export in this view.

tiles.title: What customers owe
tiles.noPrice: Amounts are not shown: they need the permission {permission}. The counts and dates stay.

list.title: By customer
list.hint: Each customer's balance split by age; a row opens the statement.
list.search: Search a customer by code or name

noMatch.title: No customer matches
noMatch.body: Change the search or the tile, or clear the filters.

empty.title: Nobody owes anything
empty.body: Every issued invoice is paid or credited as of this day.

list.creditLater: Credit limits (limit, used, available, orders on hold) come with a later release.

reminders.title: Reminders to approve

empty.sent: No reminder sent in the last 30 days

reminders.emptyBody: The ladder prepares a reminder when an invoice reaches one of its steps; a person approves it here.
reminders.wording: The reminder texts are placeholders to confirm with the accountant: read and, if needed, edit each one before approving it.

switch.offTitle: Reminders are switched off for this company
switch.offBody: Nothing reaches a customer until the Owner switches them on (after the go-live, once the accountant has decided the late-payment rule). You can approve reminders now: they wait, approved.
switch.onBody: Reminders are switched on: an approved reminder goes to the customer at once.

blocker.NO_LADDER: The company has no reminder ladder yet.
blocker.INTEREST_UNDECIDED: The late-payment interest rule is not decided yet.

heldReason.UNPLACED_PAYMENT: Payment being processed: the customer has money on account not yet placed on an invoice. Place it first; it may pay these invoices.
heldReason.CREDIT_NOTE_DRAFT: Credit note pending: a credit note is being prepared for one of its invoices.
heldReason.CHANGED: Paid or credited since it was prepared: cancel it, the ladder prepares it again.
heldReason.NO_CONTACT: No active contact of the customer receives invoices with an e-mail address.
heldReason.SWITCHED_OFF: Reminders are switched off for the company: it can be approved, not sent.
heldReason.DEPOSIT_TO_CARRY: Deposit to carry: a deposit paid without a deposit invoice is not placed on one of its invoices yet. Carry it in Payments first; the customer may owe less than this asks.

reminder.title: {customer} — reminder
reminder.offBody: Approving now keeps it waiting, approved: it is sent once the Owner switches reminders on.
reminder.textNoPrice: The text names amounts: it needs the permission {permission}.
reminder.callText: A call: say what was agreed when you record it.

edit.title: Edit the reminder text
edit.languageHint: Another language writes the text again from its template, unless you change the text too.
edit.subject: Subject

skip.title: Skip this reminder
skip.body: A skipped reminder is never sent; its invoices count as reminded at this level, so the ladder moves on to the next step.

call.title: Call {customer}
call.body: A call is recorded with what was agreed (a promise to pay, a dispute, a new date).

statement.title: {customer} — statement
statement.subtitle: {company} · {from} → {to} · {currency}
statement.noPrice: Amounts are not shown: they need the permission {permission}.
statement.bridgeNoPrice: The balance needs the price grain.
statement.bridgeNote: Deposit invoices count too, and money received but not yet placed lowers the balance.
statement.open: Open at the end of the period
statement.dueAssumed: no due date on the invoice: its date is used

send.title: Send the statement to {customer}
send.body: The statement from {from} to {to} goes as a PDF to the customer's contacts who receive invoices, and is kept on the customer's record.
send.fake: On this installation e-mail goes through the test provider: nothing reaches a real customer.

pdf.printHeld: Wait until every statement is read.
pdf.storedNowhere: Made now from what is recorded; not stored. Send statement (on the statement) keeps a copy on the customer.
pdf.noPriceTitle: The statement needs the price grain
pdf.noneBody: Open a customer's statement on Receivables & credit and press Print.

held.pickToPrint: Choose the customers in the table first.
held.notPrepared: Only a reminder that waits for approval.
held.switchedOff: Reminders are switched off for this company: it waits, approved.
held.callInBulk: A call is recorded one at a time, with what was said: open it.
held.noRecipients: No active contact of the customer receives invoices with an e-mail address: add one on the customer.
held.text: Write a subject and a text.
held.callNote: Say what was said on the call.
held.notOpen: Only a reminder that waits (to approve or to send).

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.next: Next / previous customer or reminder in the dialog

notice.approvedWaiting_one: {count} reminder approved: it waits until reminders are switched on.
notice.approvedWaiting_other: {count} reminders approved: they wait until reminders are switched on.
notice.noneApproved: None of the reminders was approved: some cannot be.

problem.conflict: Someone changed this meanwhile: it was read again. Check and try again.
problem.signed_out: You are signed out. Sign in again.
problem.forbidden: You don't have the permission for this.
problem.not_found: Not found: it may have been removed.
problem.unavailable: The server cannot be reached. Try again in a moment.
problem.rate_limited: Too many tries: wait a moment.
problem.invalid: This was refused as it is: check what you entered.
problem.companyLegal: The statement cannot be made on the company's letterhead yet: its legal data is incomplete (registered office, VAT number, codice fiscale, REA number). Someone who manages companies completes it in Admin › Companies & sites.

refusal.NOT_PREPARED: Only a reminder that waits for approval can be changed, approved or skipped.
refusal.NOT_APPROVED: A person approves a reminder before it is sent.
refusal.FINAL: This reminder is sent, skipped or cancelled: it never changes.
refusal.SWITCHED_OFF: Reminders are switched off for this company: nothing is sent to a customer until the Owner switches them on. The reminder can be approved and waits.
refusal.NO_CONTACT: Add an active contact of the customer who receives invoices (role Invoices) with an e-mail address: the reminder goes to them.
refusal.CHANGED: Something was paid or credited since this reminder was prepared: it no longer asks what is due. Cancel it; the ladder prepares it again.
refusal.NO_TEXT: An e-mail or a letter is approved with its subject and text.
refusal.CALL_NOTE: Say what was agreed on the call.
refusal.OPEN_AT_LEVEL: A reminder of this level is already waiting for this customer: approve, skip or cancel it first.
refusal.NOTHING_OPEN: Nothing is open on these invoices.
refusal.NO_LADDER: The company has no reminder ladder: set its steps in the receivables settings first.
refusal.NOT_A_CALL: Only a call is recorded with what was said.

cancel.title: Cancel this reminder
cancel.body: A cancelled reminder is never sent and does not count as a reminder: when its invoices are still due, the ladder prepares a new one with today's amounts.
